sentences.sentence: I want to invent the Pollution Vacuum.
I want to make an easy way for students to get to school.
The Rocket Bus will be the fastest way to get to school.
The Mobile Teacher will help students study at home.
The Robot Dog will be helpful for people who want a pet.
It is going to help students get home safely.
Everyone will want the Robot Dog because it will be so cute.
That's why I am going to make this new invention.
